tasks.label: CMake: build debug
tasks.detail: Windows. Build all targets using the debug preset. Explicitly enters the VS dev shell itself (scripts/build.ps1) rather than relying on CMake Tools' environment auto-injection, which turned out to only reliably apply to a build directory CMake Tools configured itself.

tasks.label: CMake: build release
tasks.detail: Windows. Build all targets using the release preset. Explicitly enters the VS dev shell itself (scripts/build.ps1) rather than relying on CMake Tools' environment auto-injection, which turned out to only reliably apply to a build directory CMake Tools configured itself.

tasks.label: CMake: build mac-debug
tasks.detail: macOS. No dev-shell equivalent is needed - clang from the Command Line Tools is already on PATH with the right sysroot. $gcc is the correct problem matcher here: clang's diagnostic format parses with it.

tasks.label: CMake: build mac-release
tasks.detail: macOS. Release (RelWithDebInfo) build. For something distributable use scripts/deploy-mac.sh instead - it also compiles out the Debug menu, embeds Qt and produces a signed DMG.
